description: This file implements the SupService class for handling various modem supplementary service commands such as USSD, CLIR, CLIP, call forwarding, call waiting, and notifications within the Android Open Source Project's modem simulator.

classes.name: SupService
classes.description: A class that manages supplementary service commands for the modem simulator, including USSD, CLIR, CLIP, call forwarding, call waiting, and notifications.

methods.name: SupService::HandleUSSD
methods.description: Handles USSD commands, currently responds with 'OK'.

methods.name: SupService::HandleCLIR
methods.description: Handles CLIR commands, responds with current CLIR status or sets new status based on command.

methods.name: SupService::HandleCLIP
methods.description: Handles CLIP commands, responds with fixed response indicating CLIP is disabled.

methods.name: SupService::HandleSuppServiceNotifications
methods.description: Handles supplementary service notifications, responds with 'OK'.

methods.name: SupService::HandleCallForward
methods.description: Handles call forwarding commands, supports querying and setting forwarding info.

methods.name: SupService::HandleCallWaiting
methods.description: Handles call waiting commands, supports enabling, disabling, and querying status.

methods.name: SupService::InitializeCommandHandlers
methods.description: Initializes command handlers for various supplementary services.

methods.name: SupService::InitializeServiceState
methods.description: Initializes the internal state related to call forwarding information.
